duplicate_major_exceptions.rationale: Clipline and the pinned clipline-cloud-api use reqwest 0.12, while tauri-plugin-updater uses reqwest 0.13. Moving either first-party caller alone would retain both stacks and split Clipline from its cloud API; downgrading the updater would give up current security fixes. Reviewed 2026-10-25: clipline-cloud main still selects 0.12, tauri-plugin-updater 2.14.0 still requires ^0.13, 0.12.28 is the newest 0.12 patch, and RustSec lists no reqwest advisories.
duplicate_major_exceptions.remove_when: Align as soon as clipline-cloud-api and tauri-plugin-updater support the same reqwest release line; verify cargo tree contains one reqwest package before removing this exception.

controlled_forks.rationale: The maintained shiguredo_opus binding replaces unmaintained audiopus_sys. Clipline's fork of 2026.4.0 pins the reviewed Windows and Ubuntu release hashes locally instead of trusting a checksum downloaded beside the artifact, and retries flaky release downloads. Reviewed 2026-10-25: upstream 2026.4.0 fixed the Windows library name the 2026.1.0 fork patched, each pinned digest matches GitHub's upload-time asset digest and upstream's .sha256, and RustSec lists no advisories.
controlled_forks.remove_when: Return to the crates.io release after upstream embeds immutable per-target artifact hashes, or migrate to a stronger maintained binding with equivalent codec tests.
